headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth in Q2 FY27, driven by strong performance at the top firms.
summary: TCS and HCLTech reported double‑digit revenue growth and healthy operating margins. Mid‑tier players such as L&T Technology Services and Tech Mahindra also posted robust top‑line gains. AI‑related revenue is emerging as a growth theme, highlighted by HCLTech and L&T. Several peers have not yet released results, limiting full sector visibility.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: AI revenue contributions are rising, with HCLTech noting a 78% YoY jump and L&T reporting a 47% surge.

themes.title: Steady margin expansion
themes.detail: TCS maintained a 24% operating margin, while HCLTech improved to 18.2% in constant currency.

leaders.why: 21.2% YoY revenue growth and 15.6% profit increase.
Largest revenue base with 15.4% YoY growth and 24% operating margin.

laggards.why: Revenue grew 20% YoY but profit fell 25.4% YoY, leading to negative sentiment.
Revenue up only 9.1% YoY and profit slipped 1.9% YoY, with neutral sentiment.
